# Pairpoll

Pairpoll is a free poll for images and videos, ranked head to head.
Creators upload 2 to 16 items and share one voter link.
Each voter picks between pairs. Pairpoll returns each voter's top list and an overall ranking.
Agents can use the REST API, CLI or remote MCP server.

- /docs/quick-start.md

- MCP Streamable HTTP: /mcp
